content.text:
The Danube — Europe's second-longest river, flows through ten countries from the Black Forest to the Black Sea.

The Rhine — a major waterway in Western Europe, flowing from the Swiss Alps through Germany and the Netherlands to the North Sea.

The Volga — Europe's longest river, flowing through western Russia from its source in the Valdai Hills to the Caspian Sea.

Mount Everest — the world's highest mountain at 8,849 meters, located in the Himalayas on the Nepal-Tibet border.

K2 — the second-highest mountain at 8,611 meters, located in the Karakoram range on the Pakistan-China border.

Mont Blanc — the highest peak in the Alps at 4,808 meters, straddling the France-Italy border.
